title: BIP39 Walkthrough Example
content:
Lets say you have successfully created unbiased entropy using out coin flip or dice roll methods and von neumann skew correction (as outlined in our [coldcard exploit article](https://btcmaxis.com/article.html?id=7554e7cb-d8aa-45d5-95c8-adea8d87ea23)). Here is a step by step walk through of how to process that entropy into a BIP39 seed.

**Remember you need to hash the raw bytes of your entropy, not the ASCII, and remember that you need to add 1 to the resulting integers to match the line numbers in the bip39 wordlist.**

Lets say my entropy is
> 11010000100010001110100100010110011100100101111101010110110111101001010001010110011010110110101101110010101000000100011111111100

I start by converting that to raw bytes which is:
> d0 88 e9 16 72 5f 56 de 94 56 6b 6b 72 a0 47 fc

I want to get my SHA256 hash of those bytes, which is:
> 83a2d18bc8f5f3016d0e436d673488f64fe988993fa0df2d7a528c08563950aa

You can accomplish these first three steps on an air gapped linux laptop with the command:
> printf '%s' '11010000100010001110100100010110011100100101111101010110110111101001010001010110011010110110101101110010101000000100011111111100' \
>   | basenc --base2msbf --decode \
>   | sha256sum

I take the first 4 bits of that (because 128 bit entropy, 8 bits for 256) and thats "8" or "1000". I add that to the end of the original entropy. I now have:
>  110100001000100011101001000101100111001001011111010101101101111010010100010101100110101101101011011100101010000001000111111111001000

I split it into groups of 11:
> 11010000100
> 01000111010
> 01000101100
> 11100100101
> 11110101011
> 01101111010
> 01010001010
> 11001101011
> 01101011011
> 10010101000
> 00010001111
> 11111001000

Turned into integers I get:
> 1668
> 570
> 556
> 1829
> 1963
> 890
> 650
> 1643
> 859
> 1192
> 143
> 1992

Then I add one to each number, and find its line number in https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/blob/master/bip-0039/english.txt I get
> line 1669 = spatial
> line 571 = elder
> line 557 = easily
> line 1830 = tool
> line 1964 = voice
> line 891 = hungry
> line 651 = eyebrow
> line 1644 = sniff
> line 860 = hidden
> line 1193 = never
> line 144 = ball
> line 1993 = weekend

Congratulations, you just rolled your own seed. Obviously - **do not ever use this example seed or entropy in real life**

If you need assistance, we're happy to help in our discord at https://btcmaxis.com/discord
